Very filling.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Copious Mushroom Skewers can be made by [[Cooking]] at least four different types of [[Mushroom]]s together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Due to the variety of [[Added Effect]]s granted by Mushrooms, it is impossible to create any different types of Copious Mushroom Skewers aside from their default. These Skewers are popular among fans of Mushrooms. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Copious Mushroom Skewers return in {{TotK}}. Their [[Recipe]] is the same as in {{BotW}}, requiring at least four different types of [[Mushroom]]s to be [[Cooking|Cooked]] together. Since [[Skyshroom]]s are now available as a neutral [[Ingredient]], one variety of Copious Mushroom Skewers can be made that grants an [[Added Effect]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Copious Mushroom Skewers boost the [[Warrior]]s' movement speed by 15% when cooked before the start of a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], and is made using four [[Endura Shroom]]s, four [[Stamella Shroom]]s, four [[Rushroom]]s, four [[Hearty Truffle]]s, and four [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s, but this can be lowered to three of each [[Mushroom]] through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". The [[Recipe]] for Copious Mushroom Skewers is obtained by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Stumped by Shrooms]]". {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Copious Mushroom Skewers Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Copious Mushroom Skewers ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Mushroom Skewer }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Skewers |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
